title: Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class
abstract: arXiv:2610.01262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. translated_title: 无需等待的反馈：在大型数学课堂中试点生成式AI练习平台
translated_abstract: 及时且具体的反馈是对学生学习影响最显著的因素之一，然而在学生与助教比例很高的大型电气工程课堂中，这种反馈难以持续提供，遇到困难的学习者可能要等待数天才能得知自己的解题方法为何出错。生成式人工智能为规模化提供对话式反馈提供了一条途径，但用它来批改计分作业会引发信任与问责方面的担忧，而通过人工审核来保证其判断的可靠性，又会重新引入那种削弱反馈价值的延迟。由此产生了一种张力：一方面是让反馈如此有效的即时性，另一方面是让反馈值得信赖的人工监督。在这项工作中，我们着手在实践中化解这一张力，设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在自主练习过程中提供即时且有支架引导的反馈，这将人工监督从实时评分环节中转移出来……
tldr: 该研究设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在大型课堂的自主练习中提供即时且有支架引导的反馈，将人工监督从实时评分中移出，从而化解了反馈即时性与人工可信监督之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: This study designs and pilots a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice in a large class, relocating human oversight away from real-time grading to resolve the tension between feedback immediacy and trustworthy human supervision.
